title.en: Major Agreements and concepts under WTO (World Trade Organization)
title.hi: Major Agreements and concepts under WTO (World Trade Organization)

definition.en: The WTO is a global international organization that deals with the rules of trade between nations, focusing on agreements that govern international commerce and agricultural subsidies.
definition.hi: The WTO is a global international organization that deals with the rules of trade between nations, focusing on agreements that govern international commerce and agricultural subsidies.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding WTO agreements is critical for GS-3 as it directly impacts India's agricultural policy, food security, and export competitiveness. Questions frequently appear on the Agreement on Agriculture (AoA) and its implications for India's Minimum Support Price (MSP) and Public Stockholding.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of WTO agreements on Indian agricultural trade.

learningOutcomes.en: Evaluate the conflict between domestic food security and international trade obligations.
